intro: Dauntless Forever is a volunteer preservation project. Everything here stands on work other people published first; this page is where they are named. No ads, no paid advantages, ever.

people.name: Addison2k
people.what: Ported the server code and backends to 1.6.2, 1.12 and 1.14.7, wrote the offline sign-in stand-in, the two-click packages, this launcher, and keeps the manifest archive.

people.name: KombatKing
people.what: 1.6.2: the Lady Luck / Trials shop (56 offers), daily Ramsgate shard pickups, the weekly Trials rotation and the safer port check.

people.name: Moyka009
people.what: Saved the 1.14.7 manifest and tested the first 1.14.7 package.

people.name: Undaunted
people.what: The private-server approach, the loader and the original backend. AGPL-3.0. The server DLLs and backends in each version are modified versions of it, with full source in every package.

people.name: meszmate/manifest
people.what: The download tool that fetches builds from Epic's servers (with a fix for uncompressed chunks).

people.name: DauntlessEndpointDocumentation
people.what: Public captures of the live servers' replies; 1.14.7 set-up downloads them for the local backend.

people.name: Dauntless Revived
people.what: The other living fork of Undaunted (1.4.4). Where a fix came from there, its author is named next to it.

supportersIntro: People supporting the project on Patreon. Support is optional, changes nothing in the game, and pays for the time and the test machines. Thank you.
supportersAnonymousNote: Some supporters chose to stay anonymous. Thank you too.
